comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
Now cheap: tools/herdr-probe attaches a control stream to any pane and records the frame envelopes and decoded ANSI verbatim (see corpus/herdr-0.8.0/frames/). What this card adds is running real agents in those panes rather than a fake, so the corpus carries what Claude Code, codex, and friends actually paint - alternate screen, kitty graphics, spinners, wide glyphs - instead of a script's marker lines.

Worth capturing per agent and per state, since the grid-snapshot harness will replay these as its oracle.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Capture Claude Code (and friends) sessions as replayable byte corpora: state transitions, heavy TUI redraws, kitty-protocol negotiation. Data files drive state-detection and rendering cases.
title: Record ANSI corpora from real agent sessions
